fusions.name: Riverbank Snatch
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and strikes it for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Darting Shoal
fusions.desc: Darts 3 jets of water in a spread, each dealing 6 damage to the first enemy it meets. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it. You hold 4 charges and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you and increases your movement speed by 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Escape
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a ward that absorbs 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
